title: CRCHUM-CITADEL/nextflow-cbioportal pipeline parameters
description: Converts oncoanalyser 3.0 WGS/WTS output and ARGO/MOHCCN clinical CSVs into cBioPortal study files

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

genomic_samplesheet.description: Path to the genomic samplesheet: one row per subject, pointing at its oncoanalyser output directory.
genomic_samplesheet.help_text: Comma-separated file with a header row and the columns group, subject_id, sample_id, folder. Generate it with bin/generate_samplesheet.py; see docs/usage.txt.

clinical_samplesheet.description: Path to the clinical samplesheet: one row per ARGO/MOHCCN clinical CSV.
clinical_samplesheet.help_text: Comma-separated file with a header row and the columns group_id, filetype, filepath, extraction_date, info (info may be empty). Generate it with bin/generate_clinical_samplesheet.py; see docs/usage.txt.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

mode.description: The pipeline mode you'd like to run. Either 'clinical', 'genomic', or 'both'

type.description: Sequencing data type for the genomic workflow: 'both' (DNA+RNA) or 'dna-only'. dna-only skips all RNA-derived processing (Isofox expression/fusion, SAGE RNA-append) and the expression profile, even if RNA files are present.

run_ml.description: Also build the machine-learning feature tables (<group>/machine_learning/). Off by default; genomic and both modes only.

sample_registrations.description: Path to sample_registrations.csv for template clinical output (used when no clinical_samplesheet is provided).

study_options.title: cBioPortal study options
study_options.description: Metadata written into meta_study.txt and the cancer type files.

study_id.description: Study identifier used for meta_study.txt name and the top-level output folder for all files.

project_description.description: Project description used for the desc value of meta_study.txt.

cancer_type.description: Cancer type abbreviation for cBioPortal (e.g. mixed, lung, brca).

incremental.description: Set on a follow-up load into a study cBioPortal already holds: meta_study.txt, cancer_type.txt and meta_cancer_type.txt are skipped so the study and cancer type are not registered twice. Per-subject output caching is automatic and needs no flag.

reference_data_options.title: Reference data options
reference_data_options.description: Reference data comes from the versioned resource kit (docs/resources.md).
reference_data_options.help_text: Pass --resources_dir and every reference file is read from the kit. The hidden parameters in this group override single kit files; use --showHidden to list them.

resources_dir.description: Extracted resource kit directory (the one holding VERSION); every reference file is read from it.

cosmic_data.description: Path to COSMIC fusion TSV for ML SV processing (only used with --run_ml).

mafsmith_retain_ann.description: Comma-separated VEP CSQ subfields to retain as extra MAF columns beyond mafsmith's 53 standard ones. Names must match fastVEP's CSQ field list; an unknown name yields an empty column. Empty disables the flag.

resources_version.description: Kit version this release needs; must match resources_dir/VERSION.

ensembl_annotations.description: Ensembl 113 BioMart TSV (gene/Entrez mapping for CNV, SV and expression).

vep_data.description: VEP cache directory used by PCGR.

chimer_data.description: ChimerKB fusion workbook for ML SV.

cancer_hotspots_data.description: cancerhotspots.org snapshot; fetched live if absent.

mohccn_primary_site_map.description: Path to MOHCCN primary site mapping CSV (ICD-O topography codes).

mohccn_specimen_tissue_source_map.description: Path to MOHCCN specimen tissue source mapping CSV.

mohccn_treatment_intent_map.description: Path to MOHCCN treatment intent mapping CSV.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Container images. Site configs point these at prebuilt .sif files for offline compute nodes.

container_r.description: R image for bin/ scripts (oras://, docker:// or a local .sif).

container_python.description: Python image for bin/ scripts (oras://, docker:// or a local .sif).

container_pcgr.description: PCGR/CPSR image (oras://, docker:// or a local .sif). Must match the kit's PCGR bundle and VEP cache.

container_sigprofiler.description: SigProfilerAssignment image (oras://, docker:// or a local .sif).

container_mafsmith.description: mafsmith + fastVEP image used for VCF to MAF (oras://, docker:// or a local .sif).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id of nf-core/configs to load institutional profiles from.

custom_config_base.description: Base location of nf-core/configs; set to a local path for offline runs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when the pipeline fails.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming webhook URL (Slack or Microsoft Teams) for completion notifications.

input_dir.description: Unused; kept so existing configs that set it still validate.
